name: Support to Outbound Access Protection (OAP) on Fabric Warehouse and SQL Endpoints
description: ### Outbound Access Protection (OAP)**Outbound Access Protection (OAP)** is a security feature in Microsoft Fabric designed to control and restrict outbound network connections from Fabric workspaces. It helps prevent unauthorized data exfiltration by enforcing policies that limit which external endpoints can be accessed. OAP works in conjunction with other network security controls, such as Workspace Private Link, to provide comprehensive protection against data leaks and ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
